consequence.statement: A new optional customization was added; the evidence describes no breakage or required action.

original.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds an option to customize the signature algorithm; the evidence does not say which field or setting carries it.

decision.reason: [ev-87995aee2ded] lists this under Feature and says only that customizing the signature algorithm is now allowed. That describes a new opt-in capability, with no breakage, rejection, changed default or required step. A consequence of "none" (informational) with low severity matches what the evidence says. The note does not explicitly confirm that defaults are unchanged, so confidence is low.
